description: C2SP tlog-cosignature ML-DSA-44 (key-id algorithm byte 0x06) signed payload: label[12]='subtree/v1\n\0' || opaque cosigner_name<1..255> || uint64 timestamp || opaque log_origin<1..255> || uint64 start (MUST be 0 for checkpoints) || uint64 end (= tree size) || raw 32-byte root hash. Length-prefixed fields carry a single length byte. NOTE the coverage asymmetry: this struct covers (origin, size, root) only — extension lines are covered by 0x04 text cosignatures, never by 0x06.
signature: keyID[4] = SHA-256(name || 0x0A || 0x06 || raw 1312-byte public key)[:4]; line blob = keyID || uint64BE timestamp || 2420-byte ML-DSA-44 signature
